_: The catalogue — the one written copy. Edit here, run `npm run sync` at the repository root. See shared/README.md.
_truth: The DATABASE is the authority, not this file. /api/catalogue serves what the shop has actually set, and both surfaces prefer it. This is what seeds a fresh database, and what a customer with no signal sees; treat any disagreement with the API as the API being right.
_money: price_minor is qəpik — 6500 is 65.00 AZN. unit_kind is kg, g or pc and drives the per-kilo badge; unit_qty is in that unit.
